jobs.description:
As a Maintenance Handyman, you will make sure our warehouse, facilities and surrounding areas are kept safe, functional and well-maintained.

Your tasks will include:

- Carrying out small repairs and maintenance jobs throughout the company.
- Repairing and maintaining lockers, doors and other facilities.
- Helping to keep the warehouse and surrounding grounds in good condition.
- Identifying maintenance issues and solving them where possible.
- Supporting colleagues with various practical tasks.

Every day is different, so you won't be sitting behind a desk. It's an active and varied job where you are constantly on the move and working with your hands.

We are looking for someone who:

- Is practical and enjoys fixing and making things.
- Has basic technical knowledge and is comfortable using tools.
- Is proactive and can work independently.
- Is reliable and takes pride in their work.
- Enjoys an active working environment.
- Can communicate in English, Spanish or Romanian.
- Previous experience in maintenance, construction, facility services or a similar role is a plus, but not required.

As a production employee you will assemble bicycles! For this you use your technical skills and you know how to assemble the (electric) bicycles quickly. Furthermore:

Before your shift starts, you will visit the canteen for a good cup of coffee or tea. You might also have chat with your colleagues. You've probably heard of Giant! The most famous bicycle brand in the Netherlands! As a production employee, you will work at this great company
